raw.independence: No production metric/schedule/native-validation helper imported. Raw counts, ratios and PCG64 bootstrap are local.
raw.limits: Compact scalar/trace evidence only; no model or optimizer tensors loaded.

evidence_limits: Compact receipts recheck recorded counters, rates, bindings, metrics and runtime validation outcomes.
Full weights, Adam moments and RNG payloads are not reloaded by this audit; exact state restoration is runtime receipt evidence.
No independently reconstructed token logits or prefix masks: native support/controller claims rely on published execution source and runtime contract checks.
Worker/event/training times overlap and must not be added; summed occupied-card time is distinct from elapsed time.
No serving efficacy analysis is performed here.

original_reader_failure: First raw audit stopped after 182398 successful checks because it expected production PRESENTATIONS.jsonl. Production rows are in event RESULT.json; the private reader was corrected to the published schema. Original failure remains retained. No model work or scientific criterion changed.

publication.note: Publication auditor corrected its own input-row expectation from258 to514 including adaptation; original private reader failure retained. No scientific or public measurement changed.
